steps.label: entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat co2pa? > co2.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q co2.tgz)" = 1b98161f0ef48475a095de47dc057212 ] && mkdir -p co && rm -rf co/bundle && tar xzf co2.tgz -C co && for f in co/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls co/bundle | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render co/bundle P co_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i co_out.mp4 -i co/mixm.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest co_film.mp4 && ls -l co_film.mp4 > co_done2.txt
